newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ometraco, General Accident in j.v. deal.
newsitem.headline: Ometraco, General Accident in j.v. deal.

text.p: Indonesia's conglomerate PT Ometraco Corporation announced on Tuesday it will set up a joint venture insurance company with a unit of General Accident Plc of the United Kingdom.

Ometraco will hold a 40 percent stake through subsidiary PT Ometraco Arthaguna, while the remaining 60 percent will be owned by General Accident Insurance Asia Ltd, owned by General Accident, Ometraco said in a statement.
The new insurance firm called PT Asuransi General Accident Ometraco was expected to commence operations next January 2 with a paid-up capital of 15 billion rupiah, it said.
The statement did not give further details.
